lines.trans: In Season Three of Twelve Singers, Team Xin Huimei's debut performance is about to take the stage!
For her very first competition song, Xin Huimei has brought in a mysterious wild-card singer to perform alongside her.
Not even the mentors of our other teams know this singer's true identity.
This next song left a vivid mark on Chinese pop music history — please enjoy!
Hello, Xingtian chief editor's office.
Is everything going well back there?
It's you? I'm doing well.
Is the work going smoothly? None of you have reached out to me.
Nothing unusual happened at work, except there was one detail on Twelve Singers that felt slightly off to me.
What happened?
Though the broadcast ratings were phenomenal! Are you doing okay — eating well, and how is your stomach?
My stomach is fine. Good.
